notes.title: Major Demo Update Version 0.8!
notes.notes:
Version 0.8 of the demo is now live! This update adds new systems, buildings, and balance changes while also fixing a number of long-standing issues. Thank you to everyone who has been testing the demo and sending feedback. It’s making a huge difference as Repterra heads toward Early Access.



New in V0.8



New trophy reward system for completing levels

Fixed uranium patch spawning killing bug

Reworked promotion system, much easier to promote units now

Reinforcements tip indicator (right click)

New Pause Time Visual Effects, can be disabled in settings if you don’t like it

Attack towers and power plants are now cheaper

Bases now start with more ore nearby

Flags and snow now pause when the time pauses

Setting to invert mouse panning when control wheel held (settings->controls)

Audio setting for Advisor voice only

Added hotkey labels

New Info hover button in HUD for unit/building expanded info

Adjusted horde AI

New stalking behaviour when enemies are chasing you

Command center now provides more baseline dollars

Balanced Insane difficulty

New Scatter command (hotkey = comma)

Updated harvesting preview system so it’s easier to see which tiles provide resources

AI fixes

New starcraft style left-click to attack move (must be enabled in settings->controls)

New kill / tame counter for each unit

Reworked notification system

Supply crates now include many types of dinos

Supply crates can now permanently clear fog around a large radius

Supply crates now provide food, electricity, dino eggs, lumber, ore, uranium

DNA points are awarded in crates, and an option in wave rewards

Promoted units now have more health

Dimos now have more visibility range

New lookout tower building

New Hospital capturable building

Reworked AI to stop motionless bug

New Outpost building

Archelons can now transport human units

Many bugs and AI fixes



If you haven’t yet, please consider leaving a review on the demo page. It only takes a moment and helps Repterra gain visibility on Steam while we keep improving the game. Stay tuned there is much more to come!

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE - V0.7 and Tiny Teams Stream
notes.notes:
Repterra V0.7 Now Live



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44913111/69c1d8d0d423ed9e81c2314de1df122ed294ec70.gif"]



The V0.7 update is out. This build focuses on new features, balance changes, and a number of fixes that should make the game run smoother and play better:



Reworked settings UI, controls

Newly reworked Audio System with advanced settings for each sound type (Master, Music, Effects, Interface, Ambient, Voice)

Adjusted difficulty balancing (easy is easier, hard/very hard/insane are harder, normal stays the same)

Resolved cursor input lag issue

Breeding dinos now oscillate

Economy multipliers (bank, warehouse etc) now have animated icons to show the buildings they affect

Updated breeding indicators when max breeding capacity has been reached

New Upgrade hotkey (U) . Toggle UI key is period, had to reset bindings file so you will have to redo any custom binding you made sorry about that

Various balancing and improvements

A notification will trigger if your dollar stockpile is full for too long

Currency UI now shows a warning indicator when you are at max capacity

Market now auto sells excess resources

Changed add to selection hotkey to shift instead of ctrl

alternate hover selection hotkey is backquote

New UI toast for ‘Group X Created’ or selected

Tamed dinos can now patrol

Now easier to assign dinos to breedery, breedery can also be sold

Dimorphodon and Archelon are now breedable

Tamed enemy dinos can now be bred

Adjusted balancing for tamers, slow effect, and baryonyx

New Auto Ride feature, auto pairs riders with rideable dinos (hotkey R)



The Tiny Teams Fest is still running. Repterra will be featured on the official Tiny Teams stream on August 14th, so keep an eye out if you want to see it played live.



As always, feedback is appreciated. If you run into bugs, strange AI behavior, or balance issues, post them in the discussions or send them directly so they can be addressed in the next patch.



Thanks to everyone who has been testing and sharing thoughts. Every bit of feedback helps make Repterra a better game. If you enjoyed the demo, please take a moment to leave a review here: 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3268620/Repterra_Demo/"][/dynamiclink]

-Repterra Team

notes.title: Repterra Development Update September 2024
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

I wanted to give a quick update, we are deep deep in development of Repterra.

We have most the core engine implemented. It's able to simulate 100k+ dinos at 200fps on our mahcines using parallel computing (the game is capped at 60fps so this efficiency should allow it to run well on older machines too).

A few cool things we've added so far:

-Flying dinos that spit acid from above (and anti-air cannons to shoot them down)
-Amphibious croc-like dinos that can emerge from the sea and attack your base on land.
-Soldiers that can deploy with sandbags, giving extra attack damage and range
-15+ base buildings
-Soldiers that can garrison neutral buildings on the map
-Roads, buildings, and urban environments
-Engineers that can capture neutral buildings
-Dino taming and breeding centers

We're working really hard to get the first playable version out asap. 

Sign up for our beta to get first access.

-Repterra Team
